title: Edge-Based Inventory Categorization
business: Retailers managing distributed warehouse inventory systems.
problem: High latency and bandwidth costs when sending unstructured item descriptions to centralized cloud servers for classification.
solution: Deploying the Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct model locally on edge gateways to perform real-time, structured categorization of item descriptions into JSON formats.
steps: Install the latest transformers library to ensure compatibility with the Qwen2.5 architecture.
Initialize the model using AutoModelForCausalLM with device mapping for local hardware acceleration.
Define a system prompt that enforces structured JSON output for item classification.
Use apply_chat_template to format incoming inventory logs for the model.
Execute inference locally to parse descriptions into machine-readable categories.
outcome: Reduced dependency on external network connectivity and lower operational costs for inventory processing.
limitation: The 0.5B parameter size may lead to reduced reasoning depth compared to larger models; verify output accuracy against a validation set of complex item descriptions.

diagram.title: Edge Inference Workflow
diagram.description: The flow of inventory data from local sensors to structured JSON output.

code.content:
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
# Load model locally for edge deployment
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct", device_map="auto")
tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct")
# Prepare input with chat template
messages = [{"role": "system", "content": "Classify items as JSON."}, {"role": "user", "content": "Blue cotton shirt"}]
text = tokenizer.apply_chat_template(messages, tokenize=False, add_generation_prompt=True)
# Generate structured response
inputs = tokenizer([text], return_tensors="pt").to(model.device)
output = model.generate(**inputs, max_new_tokens=50)
code.explanation: This code demonstrates initializing the model on edge hardware and using the chat template to format inputs for structured classification tasks.
